shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "pwd && sed -n '1,240p' ../ticket.md && if [ -f ../round-brief.md ]; then sed -n '1,280p' ../round-brief.md; fi && sed -n '1,280p' .lore/dod.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short --branch && nl -ba src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts | sed -n '1,110p' && sed -n '1,240p' specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md && sed -n '1,180p' package.json && sed -n '1,160p' .lore/test-commands.yml"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts .lore/dod.md && if [ -f scripts/spec-links/reanchor.mjs ]; then node scripts/spec-links/reanchor.mjs; fi && git diff --check && git diff -- src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts .lore/dod.md && git status --short'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge --no-edit origin/main && if [ "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" != "$(git rev-parse @{upstream})" ]; then git push origin HEAD; fi && git status --short --branch && git rev-list --left-right --count @{upstream}...HEAD'
